summary: SiteDocument represents a document entity associated with a site and includes fields for identification and site linkage.
purpose: The purpose is to encapsulate document-related data for a site, likely used in document management and retrieval within the application.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site document.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin provides the interface and logic for staff administrators to view employment applications, site and discipline filters, and manage login information and page errors/warnings.
purpose: Its purpose is to facilitate staff administrators in filtering and reviewing employment applications, displaying current site and discipline information, setting up page controls, and handling errors.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: Start date filter for viewing applications.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: End date filter for viewing applications.

fields.name: cmdRefreshView
fields.description: Button to refresh the current view.

workflows.name: Employment Application Review
steps: User loads page; dropdowns for Site and Discipline are filled.
User selects start and end dates, site, discipline, and show withdrawn option.
User clicks refresh to bind and filter employment applications display.
GridView displays filtered results; additional details and links are provided.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are shown if 'Show Withdrawn' is checked.
Start date and end date are required fields; end date must not be before start date.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end date fields.
CustomValidator ensures start date is not after end date.
conditions: If user is not logged in or session incomplete, data source selection is canceled.
If site or discipline changes, data is refreshed.
system_behavior: On page load, dropdowns and filters are initialized.
On refresh or filter change, GridView data is updated.
exceptions: Page errors and warnings panels for UI errors and issues.
Empty data template for no results.

summary: ServiceCode encapsulates service code data for courses and timetables, supporting multi-language descriptions and notes, and enables listing and searching of service codes.
purpose: To provide a structured entity for service codes, supporting retrieval, localization, and association with courses and timetables.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order of sorting for the code.

workflows.name: ServiceCode Retrieval
steps: Service codes are fetched via stored procedure by session.
Alternate language fields are used if needed.
Service codes can be listed by course ID or timetable ID.

business_rules: NameAlt and NotesAlt fields are used if alternate language is set in session.
conditions: Alternate language fields used when session indicates.
system_behavior: Retrieves, localizes, and processes lists of ServiceCodes.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks historical changes to site profiles, including the details of each change, who performed it, and the affected fields, supporting audit and user visibility.
purpose: To provide an audit and historical record of changes made to site profiles for tracking and review purposes.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history record.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of the user who performed the action.

fields.name: ByOriginalUserID
fields.description: ID of the original user (if applicable).

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if the user is a system administrator.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: User triggers a search for site profile history.
System executes stored procedure and retrieves relevant records.
Details formatted and displayed to user, including who performed the action.

business_rules: Support team and system administrator status affect display formatting.
conditions: Alternate language fields are used if session indicates.
system_behavior: Retrieves, formats, and displays site profile history records.
Formats names and details for display and tooltips.
dependencies: Session for alternate language and phone mask use.

summary: EmailPopupDocument models documents presented in email popups, allowing searching and deletion of attachments and supporting folder/file management.
purpose: To facilitate search and management (including deletion) of email popup attachments, presenting documents to users and supporting file/folder housekeeping.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for email popup document.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Indicates whether the file is checked/selected.

workflows.name: Email Popup Document Management
steps: User performs search; system parses data info and presents documents.
User deletes email popup document; system deletes file and folder if possible.

business_rules: Files and folders deleted after confirming existence, errors suppressed.
conditions: File deletion attempted; folder deletion attempted after file removal.
system_behavior: Search parses and creates document entries from input string.
Deletion removes files and optionally folders, updates state.
exceptions: Errors on file/folder deletion are suppressed.
